1) How long have you had the cough and wheezing (hours, days, or weeks)?
I don’t know. My main issues are the cough and the wheezing sound when I exhale. I also have severe COPD and have had one or several COPD flare-ups in the past year.
2) Do you have any fever, chills, or increased sputum production (more mucus than usual) or change in sputum color?
I don't know.
